name: LoveSpark Core
short_description: Retro pink productivity suite for neurodivergent minds — cursor packs, site exclusions, and shared settings in one hub.
detailed_description:
LoveSpark Core is the shared hub for the LoveSpark suite of free, open-source extensions built for neurodivergent coders.

FEATURES
• Cursor Pack — 10 hand-crafted cursor themes (Retro Pink, Sakura Peach, Starlight Purple, Moonlight Rose, Candy Floss, Cyber Cherry, Mint Blossom, Golden Hour, Holographic, Obsidian Heart)
• Site Exclusions — disable LoveSpark modules on specific domains
• Data Export / Import — portable settings JSON for syncing across devices
• Retro pink aesthetic with 4 themes (retro, dark, beige, slate)
• Sparky mascot keeps you company while you work
• prefers-reduced-motion respected throughout

PRIVACY
• No tracking. No analytics. No data collection. Ever.
• Storage is local-only — nothing leaves your browser
• No remote code execution
• MIT licensed and fully open source

Who it's for: Neurodivergent developers and anyone who wants a calm, distraction-reducing browsing environment with a touch of retro pink personality.
single_purpose: Provide a shared hub for LoveSpark suite modules — cursor packs, site exclusions, and portable settings.

permissions_justification.storage: Required to persist user preferences (selected cursor theme, site exclusions, module toggles) locally in the browser. No data is transmitted off-device.
